edits.old: Then the drift test fails on any difference from sections 12 and 13 in this story and in RWB-S2-E3015-APP
edits.new:
Then the drift test fails on any difference from sections 12 and 13 in this story and in RWB-S2-E3015-APP

  Scenario: AC7 Every business rule of section 8 has a criterion or a boundary test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules table of section 8
    When the rules are traced against section 7 and section 16
    Then each of BR1 to BR9 is named by at least one criterion of section 7 or one test case of section 16
    Then the architecture constraints among them are checked by the boundary test TC-S2-E3015-CON-06 and the guardrail test TC-S2-E3015-CON-02

  Scenario: AC8 An error answer of the capture is one the provided operation declares (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the capture written through PATCH /treatments/{treatmentId} of RWB-S2-E3002-CON
    When the capture is refused with an unauthenticated, forbidden or unknown treatment request
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 as the operation declares it, and no other error status is returned for these cases
